hero.name: Jake Glick
hero.intro: Software builder from Sydney making web apps, mobile games, spreadsheet tools, data stories, study software, and a few useful things from real life.

archive.heading: The full trail lives here, and the map now has corners for the rest.
archive.intro: Main builds sit as landmarks; older experiments gather in the graveyard and learning repos live around the learning centre without crowding the harbour.

contact.heading: For projects, roles, and things worth building.
contact.intro: Email is the cleanest direct line. GitHub is the code trail. LinkedIn is the role trail.

experiences.detail: Building a gamified spreadsheet learning platform while still balancing school, product decisions, and the pull of real users.
Lead developer on What The Puck across gameplay, frontend, and backend pieces for a public mobile launch.
Worked around CommBank iQ data analytics and built a web scraper for client-market data.
Scoped a wholesale marketplace for a startup founder, including technical approach, timeline, and rough costs.
Worked on a Unity quiz app, integrating API data and turning supplied designs into mobile UI.

footer: Built from the attached DOCX, public GitHub metadata, live captures, and local project folders.
